summary: Carnegie is a dense economic worker-placement game about building an industrial empire, where you retrieve your own workers each round and use movement points to send them along a growing rail/road network to claim increasingly powerful actions. It's a heavier, more efficient descendant of the Age of Industry/Steam lineage, with a strong emphasis on engine timing and tight action economy.
praised: strong sense of building an efficient personal engine
good production and thematic integration of movement/network building
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rulebook
can feel dry/spreadsheet-y for some players
map/network building can feel fiddly at first

interaction.kind: indirect competition for action spaces and routes

scoring.why: points come from buildings, technology, endgame bonuses, and network efficiency all combined
